claim: For every real \(k\), the equation \(u_t=(u u_x)_x-k u u_x+u(1-u)\) admits the weak sharp traveling wave \(u(x,t)=\phi_k(x-c_k t)\), where \(\phi_k(\xi)=\max\{1-e^{c_k\xi},0\}\) and \(c_k=(k+\sqrt{k^2+8})/4\).

scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: Exact algebraic substitution and interface-flux matching are shown in RESULT.md. No numerical evidence or independent audit is claimed.
limitations: Only the displayed weak sharp traveling wave is established.
No uniqueness, minimality, stability, or global convergence claim is made.
The formula is proved only for D(u)=u and g(u)=u(1-u), not for D(u)=u+beta*u^2 with beta>0.

title: An exact sharp front for a degenerate Fisher–KPP equation with nonlinear advection
